stories.title: North Wales Police puts domestic abuse specialist in its 999 control room
stories.summary: A domestic abuse specialist has been placed inside the control room where North Wales Police answers 999 and 101 calls. The force announced the appointment on Monday 24 August. stories.title: Cheshire Constabulary investigating suspected arson at Chester’s ancient Minerva Shrine
stories.summary: Police are appealing for witnesses after a fire was deliberately set at the Minerva Shrine, the Roman carving in Edgar’s Field, Handbridge. stories.title: New synthetic opioids found in Welsh drug testing samples for the first time
stories.summary: More than a third of drug samples sent to a Welsh testing service over the past year did not contain the substance the sender thought they had bought, Public Health Wales has said.
